decisions.D6: b5RR4 draws predefined-team pair pickers (Pair 1 / Pair 2 / Open spot). No stored pair fields or data source exist: only the team_assignment_mode radios do. The Teams step renders those two radios as the frame segmented control; no picker, select or text input is invented.
decisions.D9: The wizard suppresses the bottom navigation (shell isSuppressed) and owns a sticky action bar that carries the bottom safe-area inset.
deviations: wHaAb draws a Match type segmented control, a Ranked switch card, date chips, a time+price row and a single venue select. The wizard renders Friendly/Competitive as a Base UI radio segmented control (Friendly first, as drawn), the Ranked switch from the existing competition resolver (on = Ranked with the League named in the meta line, off = the deliberate Unranked choice; the league control, a select, still picks the eligible League when several cover the date), suggested-day chips over the same date field as the native Date input (the custom-date path) and Start time + Price side by side. The existing fields and order (community, venue, Maps URL, photo, timezone, currency, cutoff) stay native selects/inputs on 52px controls; the venue is the saved-venue select plus the venue name and Maps URL inputs.

vAxZh draws Format (1/2/3 groups), Registration (Open/Approval/Invite only), Level range chips and a seeded invite list. The earlier claim that none of these has a source was wrong (corrected 2026-11-23): visibility (community_open | invite_only), maximum registrations and the level restriction with its minimum/maximum are real wizard fields that the Review step renders. They moved to this step: Format presets are the real maximum registrations values 4/8/12 (one group plays four players) over the same draft field as the exact Maximum registrations input (one synchronized field; empty means no limit), Registration is the visibility with two segments, and Level range chips (Any level / suggested range / Custom range) drive the existing level restriction and range inputs. Frame-only remainder, not implemented: the Approval segment (no such value exists, no alias or new enum), the sample ranges 2.5–4.0 and 3.0–4.5 and the seeded invite list (the step keeps the member search with real results and the selected-invitee Remove row).

b5RR4 and the segmented controls keep frame order after play → predefined; the Details step keeps Cancel + Continue, later steps Back + Continue, and Publish & send invites replaces the frame Publish match copy because invitations are sent on publish.

R5 F56: the top bar is the shared TopBar (centered 17/700 title between two equal side slots, 48px back target, focusable heading) and every wizard main is marked data-route-chrome="navigation", so the global language/theme chips step aside (display none, no focusable box) instead of floating over the bar; no width is reserved for them. On steps 2-4 the chevron is a button that steps back and the sticky Back keeps the visible label.
decisions.validationRouting: Next and Back never validate. Publish validates every field and returns to the step that owns the first invalid one (Details for community, date, time, venue, Maps URL, photo, competition, price, currency, cutoff and duration; Players for minimum/maximum level and maximum registrations), then focuses the first aria-invalid control of that step after it mounts (DOM order is the cross-field precedence). The cutoff error also shows on Review; the competition error stays tied to the Ranked switch or the League select.
decisions.F8: The legacy wHaAb Ranked-selector raster (full-frame budget raised to 0.19 against a measured 0.1836, paf-11) no longer exists: the wizard owns the wHaAb raster. It is re-anchored on aligned Pencil crops of the Match type control (measured 0.0442, budget 0.06) and the Ranked switch card (measured 0.0591, budget 0.08), both gated exactly on x/width/height, with the Ranked keyboard/layout probe retained in leagues-visual.spec.ts. No budget was widened to fit; the previous coarse region is replaced by crops that match the frame layout.
